environment: This machine is a home's production Home Assistant server, running this session inside a Home Assistant add-on. /config is the live configuration: it is never edited directly; changes are made in the git clones under /data/work, committed, pushed, and deployed with ha-deploy (fetch + fast-forward merge).

http://supervisor/ and ws://supervisor/core/websocket (authenticated with $SUPERVISOR_TOKEN) and the ha CLI control the real home: service calls move locks, gates, lights, heating and cameras, and Supervisor calls restart or reconfigure the system.
The hosts in ~/.ssh/config are production machines of the same home (for example the camera recorder).
soft_deny: State changes through the Home Assistant or Supervisor API or the ha CLI (service calls, restarts, reloads, registry or add-on changes) that the user did not ask for in this conversation.
Writing or deleting files under /config by any means other than ha-deploy.
Unlocking doors, opening gates, disarming alarms or turning off cameras unless the user asked for exactly that action.
